opening.argument: The speaker lays out nine passive-income methods and compares how hard each is to start, earn $100 a month from, and maintain. He also cautions that his own headline income took eight years to build and should not be expected at the start. The crypto-and-WhatsApp example is a warning about commenters impersonating him, followed by an explicit instruction not to join get-rich-quick schemes. His stock discussion describes income as potential, not guaranteed. These qualifications support an educational discussion; the cited material does not establish deception, losses, or a fraudulent transaction.
